findings.label: DB password hardcoded fallback
findings.description: database.ts falls back to password: 'postgres' when DB_PASSWORD is unset, causing a silent misconfiguration where the server starts and connects with a default credential.
findings.action: Remove the || 'postgres' fallback or throw an error when DB_PASSWORD is absent.

findings.label: Default admin seeded with PIN 0000
findings.description: migrate.ts seeds an admin user with the well-known PIN '0000' with no environment override, leaving a default credential active after every migration run.
findings.action: Read ADMIN_SEED_PIN from env (abort if absent) or remove the auto-seed and document a manual first-run step.

findings.label: Heartbeat returns stale isActive after rooted-device deactivation
findings.description: deviceController.ts reads device.isActive from the in-memory instance before device.update() on the non-created path, so a rooted device receives { isActive: true, shouldDeactivate: false } in the same response that wrote isActive: false to the DB.
findings.action: Capture the return value of device.update(updates) and use updated.isActive in the response object.

findings.label: Unused crypto-js production dependency
findings.description: crypto-js is listed in dependencies and @types/crypto-js in devDependencies but no source file imports it. All crypto work uses Node's built-in crypto module.
findings.action: Remove crypto-js from dependencies and @types/crypto-js from devDependencies in package.json.
